surfaces.name: REST API
surfaces.summary: The verification service: verify, certificate check, queued jobs, revocation list, CA keys, health.
known_limits: In release-candidate soak as part of the 2026-11-09 public flip. Graduation is a recorded gate decision scheduled for 2026-11-16 — the date alone does not graduate it.

surfaces.name: Hosted MCP
surfaces.summary: MCP endpoint for agents: same API key, same queue, seven tools (verify, job_status, check_certificate, revoked, health, usage_report, pricing).
known_limits: In release-candidate soak with the public flip; graduation is a recorded gate decision scheduled for 2026-11-16.

surfaces.name: Local MCP
surfaces.summary: The MCP server also ships in the AxiomCode repository for local use, against the same API. Documented separately from the hosted endpoint.

surfaces.name: Web verifier
surfaces.summary: Browser verification form on this site, backed by the live API.
known_limits: Browser submission was broken at the public flip (finding F-AX-10: the API lacked the cross-origin leg for the site origin) and was repaired and re-verified on 2026-11-11.

surfaces.name: Certificate checker
surfaces.summary: Browser certificate checker; the revocation list and CA public keys are public, so certificates can also be validated offline.
known_limits: Browser submission was broken at the public flip (finding F-AX-10) and was repaired and re-verified on 2026-11-11.

surfaces.name: Ask shell
surfaces.summary: Conversational access to the service. Ask renders facts from service responses and may add an explanation; it does not issue, change, soften, or predict verdicts.
known_limits: In release-candidate soak; graduation is a recorded gate decision scheduled for 2026-11-18.

surfaces.name: Ask explanations
surfaces.summary: The explanation step of the Ask shell, layered over service facts.
known_limits: Degraded-first: the explanation step may time out under load. The service facts are still returned and the missing explanation is stated. Explanation latency is an open residual carried in the soak.

surfaces.name: Free trial
surfaces.summary: The first 10 verification cases per API key are free: verdicts and usage records, never certificates.

surfaces.name: Billing / credit packs
surfaces.summary: Credit packs are priced (US$10 / $50 / $200) but not on sale. The Stripe webhook and Payment Links are deactivated until pack sales are deliberately opened.
known_limits: No purchase path is open. Checkout answers 501 while billing is paused.

surfaces.name: Paid certificates
surfaces.summary: The rule is live in the service: a completed paid verification receives a signed certificate recording PASSED or FAILED. Certificates are not purchasable while billing is paused.
known_limits: Unlock when pack sales open; the trial never produces a certificate.

surfaces.name: Smart-contract verification
surfaces.summary: Design complete 2026-11-11 (Solidity/EVM first, ingest at Yul IR, fixed property packs). Increment 0 — the feasibility spike — was approved on 2026-11-12 and is running.
known_limits: Not a current capability. Nothing on this site presents it as one.

surfaces.name: Offline / air-gapped verifier
surfaces.summary: Running the verification engine itself offline or air-gapped, for enterprise use. Approved in the build queue; not built.
known_limits: Offline certificate validation IS available today (public CA keys and revocation list). Offline verification is a different capability and is not built.

surfaces.name: L3 proof-generating agent
surfaces.summary: An agent that generates proofs for the kernel to judge. Approved in the build queue; not built. Ask explains and orchestrates existing service calls; it is not an L3 agent.

surfaces.name: Verified library (complete L2)
surfaces.summary: A complete L2 verified library. Partial L2 work exists in the repository; the complete library is not built and no completeness claim is made.
